# Calendar Money

> Your money has a calendar. A personal finance app that turns your income and expenses into a calendar, so you can plan your life. Every day shows its projected balance; add income and expenses to the dates they happen and see exactly what moves your balance.

## Key pages

- [Home / Landing](https://money.nady4.com/): marketing page with features, preview screenshots, FAQ, and sign-up call to action.
- [Register](https://money.nady4.com/register): create a free account.
- [Login](https://money.nady4.com/login): sign in to an existing account.
- [Terms of Service](https://money.nady4.com/terms)
- [Privacy Policy](https://money.nady4.com/privacy)
- [Sitemap](https://money.nady4.com/sitemap.xml)

## App routes (require login)

- `/dashboard`: calendar showing daily projected balances, drag-and-drop transaction editing, global search.
- `/stats`: cash flow metrics, category breakdowns, net worth over time, monthly/yearly views.
- `/budgets`: per-category spending limits with live progress bars and over-budget alerts.
- `/transactions`: full transaction list and search.
- `/categories`: custom income/expense categories with colors and labels.
- `/new-transaction`, `/edit-transaction`, `/scan-review`: create, edit, and AI receipt-scan review flows.
- `/account`: account settings, including optional bring-your-own vision API key for receipt scanning.
- `/new-category`, `/edit-category`: category management.

## Features

- Calendar-based projected balances: every day shows its projected balance based on scheduled income and expenses.
- Drag-and-drop transaction edits: move a transaction to another day and the date updates instantly.
- Smart statistics: cash flow, category breakdowns, net worth over time, monthly and yearly views.
- Category budgets: spending limits with live progress bars and over-budget alerts.
- Custom categories: colors and labels for income and expenses.
- AI receipt scanning: upload a receipt photo, the vision API extracts the transaction (optional BYOK API key; daily and monthly quotas).
- Global search, dark mode, CSV export, PDF export.

## Tech stack

- Frontend: Vite + React 18 + TypeScript, react-router-dom v7, MUI, Chart.js, Sass, jsPDF, Zod.
- Backend (separate repo): Node.js + Express + Mongoose (MongoDB), JWT auth, AI scan endpoints.
- Hosting: static SPA hosting with a catch-all rewrite to `index.html` for client-side routes (e.g. Vercel/Netlify).

## Repositories

- Frontend: https://github.com/nady4/calendar-money
- Backend: https://github.com/nady4/calendar-money-api

## Notes for LLMs and crawlers

- The app is a client-side rendered SPA; all routes share a single `index.html` shell.
- Auth routes require a user account and are not intended for indexing.
- The app sets no tracking cookies and includes no third-party analytics.
- Backend wire format for the scan flow: `docs/scan-invoice-backend-contract.md` in the frontend repo.
- Contact: dev@nady4.com
